items.title: China gives humanoid robots official ID numbers to track their entire lifespan
items.titleCn: China gives humanoid robots official ID numbers to track their entire lifespan
items.summary: China has begun issuing 29-character unique ID numbers to humanoid robots in Hubei province, enabling lifecycle tracking from production to decommissioning.
items.summaryCn: China has begun issuing 29-character unique ID numbers to humanoid robots in Hubei province, enabling lifecycle tracking from production to decommissioning.
